model_assistance.Bora: Image-derived groups; historical fastPLS trained on a different tile rule
model_assistance.U-Net: 397 expert-masked training images; no inference prompt
model_assistance.DeepLabV3+: 397 expert-masked training images; no inference prompt; randomly initialized ResNet-50
model_assistance.VISTA-PATH: External pretraining; predeclared limited role map; no spatial prompt
model_assistance.MedSAM: External pretraining; boxes from earlier U-Net; only three roles
model_assistance.Supervised Virchow2 response mask: 397 expert-masked training images; 32 selected channels per class; no validation label used for fitting
model_assistance.supervised_virchow2: 397 training images; 75% joint + 25% classwise PLS; final decision restricted by the frozen source-dataset label ontology; 1.5 µm contour and 400 µm² repair.

cluster_metric_rule.denominator: expert-mapped pixels; segmentation partition metrics use only pixels also covered by a positive Bora group; coverage reported separately
cluster_metric_rule.segmentation_adjusted_rand: permutation-invariant adjusted Rand index on expert tissue classes and original anonymous Bora groups
cluster_metric_rule.segmentation_matched_iou: one-to-one Hungarian group-to-expert matching; unmatched expert classes score zero; mean over expert classes present in covered pixels
cluster_metric_rule.identification: for each original group, compare fastPLS predicted class with that group’s majority mapped expert class; group and pixel-weighted accuracy conditional on covered annotated pixels
cluster_metric_rule.end_to_end: existing expert-present macro IoU of the fastPLS-colored final Bora mask, retaining the published denominator

supervised_virchow2_score.scoring_rule: Expert-present macro IoU on unmasked, ontology-gated 24-class predictions after 1.5 µm contour smoothing and 400 µm² repair, nearest-neighbor aligned to the expert frame.

figure_legend_rule: All expert classes plus mapped model colors occupying at least 1% of H&E-supported pixels in each panel. Smaller model predictions are omitted from the legend only.

selected_bora_routes.supervised: training-selected joint + classwise PLS with dataset ontology gate and contour polish
